description: Sparse visually reviewed visible-object masks for the five fixed historical 30 Hz RGB cases. Labels are evaluated only on source frames that belong to the benchmark's exact 20 Hz sampling sequence. Hidden object pixels behind RH56 are never filled.
review_policy: HSV/SAM/GrabCut candidates were generated first, then every source frame and zoomed overlay was visually checked. Ambiguous non-target appendages were removed conservatively; intrinsically ambiguous hand/object mixtures are replaced by an exact-20Hz separable frame, and empty or fully hidden targets are not labelled. Each record preserves whether it came from prior human confirmation or the current independent visual review.
